'''2018 European Championship Day 3 Koen Meijssen DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Koen Meijssen]] at [[2018 European Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Koen Meijssen]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open SYCFA Meijssen DS 2018 EC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127125624/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-championships/ Internet Archive]
